title: Bait and pay
body: The chapters you get to read hook you in. But then there is no option to watch hundreds of hours of adds to get the next chapter. Instead, they want you to buy coins and pay per chapter. Fly from here!! Be free of this scam!!!!

title: Scam
body: Don’t download. No bonus or rewards. Only way to read is purchase. I downloaded because it said free reading chapters. I didn’t realize it was only the ones I had already read

title: App that doesn’t work
body: The app that doesn’t work. I can’t login, I can’t contact customer service and yet another app that wants to bleed you dry. At least most reading apps let you earn credits. Not this one.

title: Scam
body: Don’t download if you don’t want a subscription plan. I ran into an ad that said free reading

title: Download if you want to pay $100+ for a webnovel
body: Yet another app that charges through the nose for each chapter of every webnovel, each with hundreds of chapters. The library has ebooks. Real publishers sell ebooks for a minute fraction of the cost. Don’t bother with this grift.
